{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high, especially in early horizons - requires 3-5% downward correction for first 10 days",
    "True outcomes exhibit stronger mean reversion than modeled, correcting model overconfident trends within 5-7 days",
    "Sentiment positively influences forecast accuracy - high sentiment (0.67-1.00) aligns better while negative sentiment (-0.50 to 0.00) indicates likely underperformance",
    "Price volatility is higher than model assumes - 5-10% daily variation common in true outcomes vs model's smoother 2-3% daily change",
    "Model lags behind true price turns by 1-2 days, especially at local maxima and minima - corrections should lead the model by 24-48 hours",
    "When price is in a clear uptrend (18/18 days positive), model remains reasonable but under-captures magnitude - correction should amplify by 2-3% on days 1-5",
    "Mean reversion strength correlates with sentiment - negative sentiment intervals show 3-6% faster return to mid-range values" ]}
